# Every base read as a run / 每个基读作运行

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`worlds-are-runs` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F01 · [record](worlds-are-runs.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> A world is exactly a run of the law its webs and exchanges show, and every run on webs and exchanges is a world; a world balances exactly where that run follows the law of exchange, as each does with the rest counted; a feasible course of a law of exchange and the carried amount are such runs.
>
> 世界恰是其各步之网与交换所显之律的运行，网与交换上的每个运行都是世界；世界恰在这个运行遵从交换之律处平衡，计入其余时总是如此；交换律的可行进程与所携带的量都是这样的运行。

## Laws / 规律

1. A world's web at a step (standings, activity, requirements, needs and drawing) is a configuration, and its relata's exchange a move. Every world is a run of the law it shows, every run on webs and exchanges is a world, and each reading returns the other exactly; the law a run's world shows lies within the run's law; a world's web is its run read through its dependences.<br>世界在一步的网（位、活动、所需、需要量与所取）是配置，其关系项的交换是移动。每个世界都是它所显之律的运行，网与交换上的每个运行都是世界，两个读法恰好互相还原；运行之世界所显的律在运行之律之内；世界的网是其运行经其依存读出。 (`Becoming.WebAt`, `Becoming.WebAt.dependence`, `Becoming.World.webAt`, `Becoming.World.law`, `Becoming.World.run`, `Becoming.Run.world`, `Becoming.World.run_world`, `Becoming.Run.world_webAt`, `Becoming.Run.world_move`, `Becoming.Run.world_run`, `Becoming.Run.world_law_le`, `Becoming.World.web_along`)
2. The law of exchange on webs relates two webs by an exchange in which each relatum's standing after it, with what is taken from it, is its standing before with what is given to it; the relations of dependence may change in any way. A world balances exactly where its run is a run of this law, exactly where the law it shows lies within it, and exactly where some run of it has the world's webs and exchanges.<br>网上的交换之律以一次交换联结两个网：每个关系项交换后的位加从它取走的，等于交换前的位加给它的；依存关系可任意改变。世界恰在其运行是这个律的运行处平衡，恰在它所显之律在这个律之内处平衡，也恰在这个律的某个运行有这个世界的网与交换处平衡。 (`Becoming.exchangeAt`, `Becoming.World.balanced_iff_run`, `Becoming.World.balanced_iff_law`, `Becoming.World.balanced_iff_exists_run`)
3. Every run of the law of exchange on webs is a balanced world, and a balanced world is a run of it, with the standings of the world's run of exchange; read across and back, each returns itself. With the rest counted, every world's whole web, not only its standings, is a run of the law of exchange, with no premise, carrying the world's standings, requirements and needs.<br>网上交换之律的每个运行都是平衡的世界，平衡的世界是它的运行，其位即该世界交换运行的位；来回读过，各自还原。计入其余时，每个世界的整个网（不只其位）都是交换之律的运行，不用前提，并带着世界的位、所需与需要量。 (`Becoming.Run.world_balanced`, `Becoming.World.balancedRun`, `Becoming.World.balancedRun_level`, `Becoming.World.balancedRun_world`, `Becoming.World.restRun`, `Becoming.World.restRun_web`)
4. The course a law of exchange generates, formations and conditions read as roles of one relatum, is a world standing at the generated levels; under a law of what has stood it balances exactly where the course is feasible, so a feasible course is a run of the law of exchange. Its generation, a determined process of stage and history, has one run from the start, the generated history, off which its standings are read.<br>交换律生成的进程，形成与条件读作同一关系项的角色，是一个世界，其位是律生成的水平；在读已立者的律之下，它恰在进程可行处平衡，所以可行的进程是交换之律的运行。其生成（阶段与至今历史的确定过程）从起点只有一个运行，即所生成的历史，世界的位从中读出。 (`Becoming.ExchangeLaw.courseWorld`, `Becoming.ExchangeLaw.courseWorld_level`, `Becoming.ExchangeLaw.courseWorld_balanced_iff`, `Becoming.ExchangeLaw.courseRun`, `Becoming.ExchangeLaw.courseRun_state`, `Becoming.ExchangeLaw.generation`, `Becoming.ExchangeLaw.generation_runs`, `Becoming.ExchangeLaw.courseWorld_generation`)
5. The carried amount is the standing of the world the carrying law generates, every formation active and nothing required; that world balances with no premise, so the carried amount is the standing of a run of the law of exchange.<br>所携带的量是携带之律所生成之世界的位，每个形成都活动、无所需；这个世界不用前提而平衡，所以所携带的量是交换之律的一个运行的位。 (`Becoming.carriedWorld`, `Becoming.carriedWorld_level`, `Becoming.carriedWorld_balanced`, `Becoming.carriedRun`, `Becoming.carriedRun_level`)
6. Cited from their own results: the orbit of a determined law is the run of its process, and every run of that process is the orbit from its start; readings in context are a world along every run.<br>引自各自的结果：确定之律的轨道是其过程的运行，这个过程的每个运行都是从其起点出发的轨道；语境中的读法沿每个运行是一个世界。 (`Becoming.Law.run`, `Becoming.Branching.law_run_state`, `Becoming.Contextual.world`)

## Conditions / 条件

- No axiom. A law of what has stood (Nonanticipating) and the course's feasibility are written in as hypotheses only where a course is read as a balanced world; the carrying law's strengths and gaps are supplied as in its own result; the shared index of steps and the natural-number amounts are commitments of the representation.<br>不加公理。读已立者之律（Nonanticipating）与进程可行只在进程读作平衡世界处作为假设写入；携带之律的强度与差按其自身的结果给出；共同的步序与自然数的量是表示的承诺。

## Does not show / 未表明

- That a world is a run by definition: worlds are still defined without processes, and the two readings are one by exact correspondence in both directions.<br>世界按定义就是运行：世界仍不经过程而定义，两个读法以双向恰好的对应为一。 Witness: `Becoming.World.run_world`.
- That every process is the law of some world: a process's configurations need not be webs, and reading a run's claims as a world keeps neither moves nor standings.<br>每个过程都是某个世界之律：过程的配置不必是网；把运行的主张读作世界，既不保留移动也不保留位。 Witness: `Becoming.Frame.world`.
- That every world balances: balance is a condition on a world, given with every world only once the rest is counted; likewise that the readings glue.<br>每个世界都平衡：平衡是世界的条件，只在计入其余时随每个世界给出；各读法相粘亦然。 Witness: `Becoming.World.balanced_iff_run`.
- How the course world of one kind of relatum and the course world of two roles relate: no theorem joins them.<br>一类关系项的进程世界与两种角色的进程世界怎样相关：没有定理连接二者。 Witness: `Becoming.ExchangeLaw.world`.

**Standard boundaries / 通用边界:** No ethical premise and no Lean axiom is used. 不用伦理前提，也不用 Lean 公理。 · Contains no ethical predicate and evaluates neither arising nor ceasing. 不含伦理谓词，不评价生起或消失。 · Stated for discrete steps. 按离散步骤陈述。 · A law of the formal model; its correspondence to actual systems is a separate obligation. 形式模型中的规律；与实际系统的对应是另一项责任。 · Names follow Ren's naming criteria of 10 October 2026 and are adopted where the statement has their exact meaning (Ren, 12 October 2026); readings not marked as Ren's are decided by the AI on Ren's delegation of 15 October 2026, which Ren can reverse. 名称依 Ren 2026年10月10日的命名标准，在陈述有其确切意义处采用（Ren，2026年10月12日）；未注明属于 Ren 的读法，依 Ren 2026年10月15日的交托由 AI 决定，Ren 可以改动。 · A relation omitted by a weaker description does not refute the fuller account. 较弱描述省略某一关系，不构成对较完整说明的反驳。

## Next / 下一步

A theorem joining the course world of one kind of relatum to that of two roles; making the identification definitional, which would change existing statements; an independent review; Ren's judgment on the readings and on a definitional root.<br>连接一类关系项之进程世界与两种角色之进程世界的定理；使同一化成为定义（会改已有陈述）；独立审查；Ren 对读法与对定义上的根的判断。

### Correspondence / 对应

Ren, 12 October 2026: “let's go back to main track, yes, i do agree with your reading, there are no two realities”. This result answers the integration finding of the release-readiness review: the spine had two roots, Process and World, joined by correspondence theorems, with the frontier stated on coupling arrays. Readings (the AI's, pending Ren): the root is the run because every other reading is one; a run is the unfolding read step by step, what it is at each step and how it goes on, and a world is the same unfolding read as relata of one kind exchanging; the identification is exact, so the two are one reading of one unfolding, not two things joined, and the run is no ground beneath the world. What a world adds to its run is nothing; what the law of exchange adds is the relation of standing and exchange that balance states, as a law of the run's steps.<br>Ren 2026-10-12：“let's go back to main track, yes, i do agree with your reading, there are no two realities”。本结果回答发布准备度复核的整合所见：脊柱有两个根（Process 与 World），以对应定理相连，前沿陈述在耦合阵列上。读法（AI 的，待 Ren）：根是运行，因为其他每个读法都是运行；运行是逐步读的展开，每步是什么、怎样继续，世界是同一展开读作同类关系项的交换；同一化恰好，所以二者是一个展开的一个读法，不是两物相连，运行也不是世界之下的根基。世界对其运行无所增加；交换之律所加的，是平衡所说的位与交换的关系，作为运行之步的律。
